content: OWASP primary sources describe SaaS risks including cross-tenant leakage, noisy neighbors, shared queue/cache poisoning, and incomplete offboarding. Guidance emphasizes verified tenant context propagated through requests and async jobs, tenant-aware authorization, quotas, deletion/backup policy, audit logs, and negative isolation tests. SSRF guidance recommends destination allowlists and egress controls; prompt-injection guidance says delimiters and filters are not enforcement boundaries; API4 recommends operation limits, input bounds, spend controls, and throttling. Official pages were fetched directly, but the provider confidence classifier returns LOW.
